result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority, matching the sales-rep list.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 10021). I swapped the `ORDER BY` for the same `CASE` expression the sales-rep method uses, and updated the Javadoc to describe the new order. Closed tickets and other regions are still filtered out as before.

The offline run of `TicketsPerRegionTest`, `TicketsPerSalesRepTest`, `SupportTicketTest` and `ClosedTicketsTest` passed with no output. No existing test covers this method's ordering directly, so I did not verify your T-1 to T-5 example against the database. I did not add a test, to keep the change small. Nothing is committed.
